lines.text: I'm looking for the East Gate of Lake Hall.

lines.text: There's a gate right here. Do you mean this one?
lines.speaker: Ella

lines.text: Is this the entrance on Mill Road?

lines.text: No, this is the South Gate on Hill Road.
lines.speaker: Ella

lines.text: My ticket says East Gate, next to a coffee shop.

lines.text: Right, that's the one on Mill Road.
lines.speaker: Ella

lines.text: So I need Mill Road, not Hill Road. Is that right?

lines.text: Yes. Walk around the building to the coffee shop.
lines.speaker: Ella
